claim: In AWS Config pricing example 1 (US East (N. Virginia), 10 configuration items recorded from each of 100 EC2 instances in a 24-hour period), continuous recording records 10 configuration items per resource, while under periodic recording only 1 configuration item per resource is generated per day; the example prices are $0.003 per continuous configuration item and $0.012 per periodic configuration item.

qualifiers.condition: worked example in which each resource has 10 configuration items in 24 hours

evidence.quote: Under continuous recording 10 configuration items were recorded per resource. Under periodic recording, only 1 configuration item per resource is generated per day.
100 periodic configuration items * $0.012 per periodic configuration item = $1.20
1000 continuous configuration items * $0.003 per continuous configuration item = $3.00

You have the following usage in the US East (N. Virginia) Region in a 24-hour period: 10 configuration items are recorded from each of 100 Amazon EC2 instances for a total of 1000 configuration items.
